verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Loops supports lifecycle email use cases like onboarding, activation, upgrade, and winback sequences (loops-docs-15) and event-triggered workflows via API (loops-docs-3), but there is no documentation of branching logic, time-based delays, or exit-rule conditions within a visual automation builder. missing for 10: explicit branch/condition support, delay/wait-step configuration, exit-rule mechanics, and independent confirmation of a multi-step workflow builder.
